fusions.name: Curl Charge
fusions.desc: Barrels into the target, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Scute Crush
fusions.desc: Rolls into the target from up to 5 tiles, dealing 28 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range. The blow ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Overlap
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Seamless Back
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
